answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging verifiable delay functions to ensure computational infeasibility of identity cloning; a malicious agent attempting to clone identities would need to solve a ferrous problem, akin to finding a comet amidst a vast, computationally intractable space, thereby rendering such attacks impractical; the vine of trust is strengthened by binding reputation to unique, verifiably delayed outputs, ensuring information-theoretic unforgeability and Byzantine fault tolerance.
